articlefeedback-botname: Username of the account that posts feedback to article talk pages. Account is auto-created and added to the bot group on first use if it doesn't already exist.
articlefeedback-talk-heading: Heading for the new talk-page section created per feedback submission. $1 is a wikitext link to the submitter's user page, or a fixed string for anonymous submissions.
articlefeedback-talk-body: Body of the new talk-page section. $1 is the submitted feedback text.
articlefeedback-talk-summary: Edit summary used for the bot's talk-page edit.
